rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Blast
rules.description: If the target is hit all models within 4“ of it are also hit by this weapon.

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Caster Group
rules.description: This model counts as having Caster(1).

rules.name: Crossing Attack
rules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Extra Reach
rules.description: If this model has Extra Reach, it gets +8"/+4" range when shooting/charging from Extra Reach (instead of only +4"/+2").

rules.name: Enhanced Highborn
rules.description: If this model has Highborn, it gets +8"/+4" range when shooting/charging from Highborn (instead of only +4"/+2").

rules.name: Enhanced Highborn Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Highborn. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Extra Reach
rules.description: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.

rules.name: Fracture
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Highborn
rules.description: This model gets +4"/+2" range when shooting/charging.

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting.

rules.name: Hit & Run Shooter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Hit & Run Shooter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Piercing Spotter
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 30" and in line of sight of this model and roll one die, on a 4+ place a token on it. When attacking, friendly units may remove tokens from their target before rolling to block to get +AP(X) on their weapons, where X is the number of removed tokens.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Regeneration Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Regeneration. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Scout
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Scout Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Shred in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shred when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Shred on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Spell Conduit
rules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Spell Resistance
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

rules.name: Spell Resistance Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Spell Resistance. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable Shooter
rules.description: When shooting, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unwieldy
rules.description: Strikes last when charging.

spells.name: Blessing of Souls
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Enhanced Highborn once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Creator of Illusions
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Elemental Seeker
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 1 hit with Blast(3).

spells.name: Hidden Spirits
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Unpredictable Shooter once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Psy-Destruction
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 24" in line of sight, which takes 3 hits with AP(4). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Shattering Curse
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Fracture. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.
